description: This file defines core classes and constants for CKEditor, including the CKEDITOR.editor class, its methods, and related constants for element modes.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.editor
classes.description: Represents an editor instance with methods for creation, initialization, and event handling.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.editor
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new editor instance with configuration, linked element, mode, and initial data.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.editor.replace
methods.description: Replaces a textarea or DOM element with a CKEditor instance.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.editor.appendTo
methods.description: Creates a new editor inside a specific DOM element.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the editor instance, to be overridden by full implementation.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires an event, passing the editor instance automatically.

methods.name: fireOnce
methods.description: Fires an event once, passing the editor instance automatically.
